blocks.text: Oscar-winning actress Michelle Yeoh was visibly delighted during her recent visit to the Philippines after spending time with her friends including Heart Evangelista and her senator husband Francis “Chiz” Escudero. Yeoh, who was earlier in the country for the special screening of her series “Blade Runner 2099,” shared photos from the meeting through her Instagram page on Thursday, Nov. 26.
